categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and updates WalletBatch DB read/write/erase handling across core wallet files.
categories.rationale: Handling unhandled database write failures prevents in-memory and on-disk state desynchronization that can lead to wallet corruption or data loss. The PR marks database operations as [[nodiscard]] and updates callers to propagate errors or document ignored failures, resolving systematic reliability and consistency risks in the wallet storage layer.
